name: Adashino Hachirou
source:
A rickshaw puller, who calls himself Adashino. He does not stop in one town. Pulling his rickshaw, he appears everywhere [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] goes.

Is this merely a coincidence? Or, perhaps, Adashino acts based on some sort of calculations? In any case, he only dodges the suspicions with a faint smile.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
